English: The Apostatic Union was formed roughly forty years ago, after its various member realms defeated the Wikkans in the God War. Their shared belief is that, for humanity to prosper, gods and god-worshippers must be expelled from human society. In the Union, to call someone 'devout' is an insult indeed.
Chinese: 叛教联盟成立于约四十年前，其各成员领在神之战中击败维坎教团之后。他们共同的信念是：人类要繁荣，就必须把神明与神明崇拜者逐出人类社会。在联盟，骂人"虔信"可是相当重的侮辱。

English: Even before the World Rend, Wikkan covens dominated the sky realms. The various Wikkan covens would negotiate pious contracts between men and gods, holding each to strict codes of conduct. The Apostatic Union, seeking the freedom to pursue their own study of cipher magic, defeated the Wikkans in the God War; and now their power is much diminished.
Chinese: 早在世界撕裂之前，维坎女巫团便主宰着天空诸陆。各维坎女巫团为人与神谈判虔诚的契约，令双方恪守严格的行为准则。叛教联盟为追求自由研究密文魔法，在神之战中击败了维坎教团；如今维坎的势力已大幅衰落。

English: A catchall term for the various brigands and ruffians inhabiting the Oneiric Isles. Being on the fringes of Apostatic Union territory, those islands have been relatively lawless until recently; with numerous criminal gangs finding safe haven there. Though they are often in competition with one another, word travels fast among the Outlaw gangs and it is possible to garner a reputation as a mercenary of note.
Chinese: 这是对盘踞梦幻群岛的各路匪徒与暴徒的统称。由于地处叛教联盟疆域的边缘，这些岛屿直到不久前还相对法外逍遥，众多犯罪团伙在此寻得避风港。尽管他们常常互相竞争，消息在法外之徒各帮派间传得飞快，你有可能博得一名知名佣兵的名声。

English: A mercenary band led by Vela Callose, the Dark Star Company is infamous across the Apostatic Union for their villainous deeds. It is said they will do anything for coin, and that they have amassed vast funds. They were last seen on the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 黑星佣兵团由薇拉·卡洛斯统领，因其恶行在叛教联盟恶名昭著。据说他们为了钱什么都干得出来，并且积攒了巨额资金。他们最后一次现身是在梦幻群岛。

English: Loyal to the Queen of Silver, the Endless Royalists believe in honouring their monarch's intent. This includes feeding upon Penitent Thaw's mindless meat in place of sentient flesh. Such a stance has helped repair relations with mortal factions in the skyrealms over the past century or so.
Chinese: 无尽保皇派忠于白银女王，坚信应遵从君主的意愿。这包括以忏悔者·索培育的无意识血肉取代有意识血肉为食。这样的立场在过去一个世纪左右，帮助修复了与天空领域凡人各派系的关系。

English: The Endless Cadavers are a shadowy bunch, loosely organised under Lord Rhydder's command. They believe in returning to the dark days of the Cadaver Crusades, in which the endless would invade neighbouring islands and feast upon mortal flesh. This would, of course, be in stark defiance to the wishes of the Queen of Silver.
Chinese: 无尽尸骸派是一群阴影中的家伙，在里德尔勋爵的指挥下松散地组织起来。他们主张回归尸骸十字军的黑暗时代——那时无尽者会入侵邻近岛屿，大啖凡人血肉。这当然与白银女王的意愿背道而驰。

English: A peculiar bunch of humanoid creatures, goblins are native to the Oneiric Isles. They are often seen wearing crafted wooden masks, attire that is said to be worn in an act of penitence for some past misdeed. They live in harmony with the forest and are especially fond of the giant moths found there.
Chinese: 哥布林是一群奇特的人形生物，原生于梦幻群岛。它们常戴着手工木面具——据说佩戴面具是为过往的恶行忏悔。它们与森林和谐共生，尤其钟爱林中的巨型飞蛾。

English: Ghosts and skeletal constructs. It is well documented that reviving a living being from the dead is impossible with cipher magic; but that does not stop certain souls from clinging to existence in some pathetic mockery of life.
Chinese: 幽灵与骸骨造物。有充分记载表明，以密文魔法将生者从死亡中复活是不可能的；但这挡不住某些灵魂以生命可悲的拙劣仿品苟延残存。

English: Artificial constructs, often hostile to life. Many machines were produced in Kardova during the God War, and this legacy has continued since the founding of the Clockwork Kingdom. If these terrible machinations had some beneficial purpose, it is long forgotten; they roam wildly, attacking any threat their sensors detect.
Chinese: 人工造物，通常对生命充满敌意。许多机械是神之战期间在卡尔多瓦生产的，这一传统自发条王国建立以来延续至今。这些可怕的机械装置若曾有过什么有益用途，也早已被遗忘；它们肆意游荡，攻击传感器侦测到的任何威胁。

English: Followers of a new goddess, deep below the Endless. Crystals grow from within.
Chinese: 一位新女神的信徒，深居于无尽领域之下。水晶自内生长。

English: Belief is everything. As your delusions grow, so does your power. Find enough Glimmers of Delusion - by exploring the world, or completing quests - and they will grant a full Delusion. Delusions can be spent to increase one of your core attributes.
Chinese: 信念即一切。妄想越多，力量越强。通过探索世界或完成任务收集足够多的妄想微光，它们将合成为完整的妄想。妄想可用于提升你的核心属性。

Chinese: 提升你的体力上限。掌管开锁与敏捷技能。

Chinese: 提升你的法力上限。掌管博识与施法技能。

Chinese: 你死亡前所能承受的伤害量。通过休息或药水恢复。

English: Required to successfully cast certain spells. Replenished with rest or potions.
Chinese: 成功施放特定法术所必需。通过休息或药水恢复。

English: Modifies attack damage and, at low levels, your skills. Maximum stamina depletes over time, but can be replenished by resting.
Chinese: 影响攻击伤害，过低时还会影响你的技能。体力上限会随时间消耗，可通过休息补充。

English: The speed at which your Stamina regenerates.
Increases damage done with all physical weapons.
Chinese: 提升所有物理武器造成的伤害。

English: Increases the chance of successfully picking a lock or disarming a trap. Requires lockpicks, which break upon failure.
Chinese: 提升成功开锁或解除陷阱的几率。需要开锁器，失败时开锁器会折断。

English: Knowledge of ancient truths. Allows interaction with concealed mechanisms, to reveal hidden secrets.
Chinese: 关于古老真相的知识。可与隐藏机关互动，揭示隐秘。

English: The ability to influence others through dialogue. Can reveal important information or resolve difficult encounters.
Chinese: 通过对话影响他人的能力。可套出重要情报，或化解棘手的遭遇。

English: Decreases damage received by enemy combatants.
Chinese: 减少敌人攻击对你造成的伤害。

English: Increases movement speed and jump height.
Chinese: 提升移动速度与跳跃高度。

English: Increases the potency of spells, and how quickly you can call upon them.
Chinese: 提升法术威力与施放速度。

English: Allows for more favourable deals. Buy low and sell high.
Chinese: 让交易条件更有利。低买高卖。

Chinese: 基于护甲与防御，综合减伤为

English: Your Armour rating, based on the clothing and equipment you wear. Reduces damage taken by enemy attacks.
Chinese: 你的护甲等级，由所穿衣物与装备决定。减少敌人攻击造成的伤害。

English: The total damage you do with the weapon in this slot. A combination of your Attack skill and the weapon's base damage.
Chinese: 你用该栏位武器造成的总伤害。由你的攻击技能与武器基础伤害共同决定。

English: The world was long ago broken, its surface cursed. ##You are a dweller of the Skyrealms; drifting islands that cradle the last of human civilisation. ##Here, in the dank cell of an Inquisition ship, you ruminate on your past.
Chinese: 世界早已破碎，地表遭到诅咒。##你是天空领域的居民——那些漂流的岛屿承载着人类文明的余烬。##此刻，在宗教裁判所船舰阴湿的牢房里，你回想着自己的过去。

English: Dreams of childhood slip through your mind. Was your fate sealed, even then?
Chinese: 童年的梦境从脑海中滑过。你的命运在那时就已注定了吗？

English: The body grew, the mind sharpened. For a while you excelled.
Chinese: 身体成长，心智锐利。你曾有一段出类拔萃的日子。

English: Cracks showed, your guard slipped. The mistake was grave - the Inquisition had your scent.
Chinese: 裂缝显现，警惕松懈。错误极其严重——宗教裁判所嗅到了你的踪迹。

English: Dreams of childhood slip through your mind. Was your fate sealed, even then?
Chinese: 童年的梦境从脑海中滑过。你的命运在那时就已注定了吗？

English: The body grew, the mind sharpened. For a while you excelled.
Chinese: 身体成长，心智锐利。你曾有一段出类拔萃的日子。

English: Cracks showed, your guard slipped. The mistake was grave - the Inquisition had your scent.
Chinese: 裂缝显现，警惕松懈。错误极其严重——宗教裁判所嗅到了你的踪迹。

English: The idea of battle captivates you; it always has. You started by smashing sticks, before long you were clashing swords. There was never any question; you were a fighter through and through.
Chinese: 战斗的念头让你着迷；一贯如此。你从抡棍子开始，没过多久就在挥剑对拼了。这从不是个问题；你彻头彻尾就是个战士。

English: Growing up, you were nobody; just another malnourished child clogging the city. Without the street gang you'd have died like the rest. They taught you to see what others didn't, to slip in where others couldn't. They taught you to survive.
Chinese: 长大过程中，你无名无姓；不过是又一个挤在城里的营养不良的孩子。没有街头帮派，你会像其他人一样死去。他们教你看见别人看不见的东西，钻进别人钻不进的缝隙。他们教你活下去。

English: As a child of remarkable promise from an unremarkable family, your parents sold you to a passing scholar. Your youth was spent copying tomes till your hands bled; but what you read, you did not forget.
Chinese: 你是平凡家庭里天赋出众的孩子，父母把你卖给了一位路过的学者。你的青春在抄写典籍中度过，抄到双手渗血；但你读过的东西，一个字也没有忘。

English: A child of noble birth, you were dining with foreign dignitaries before you could walk. You learned manners and etiquette, but more than anything, tenacity - for the glittering halls of Riova can be more cutthroat than the darkest of alleys.
Chinese: 出身贵族的你，还没学会走路就与外国要人共进晚餐。你学会了礼仪与规矩，但最重要的是坚韧——因为里奥瓦金碧辉煌的大厅，可能比最黑暗的小巷还要凶险。

English: You were drafted into the Apostatic Union's military. The God War might have ended, but the hunt for cultists had not. You toured the Union's fringes, fighting occult insurgents in bloody skirmishes - and seeing friend and foe cut down.
Chinese: 你应征入伍，加入叛教联盟的军队。神之战或许结束了，但对邪教徒的围剿没有。你转战联盟边陲，在与神秘叛乱分子的血腥冲突中作战——眼睁睁看着敌友接连倒下。

English: You joined a band of mercenaries, selling your swords to the highest bidder. When work was slow, you scavenged ruins or wrecked sky-ships to make ends meet. Before long you were as deft with lockpicks as a blade.
Chinese: 你加入了一支佣兵团，把剑卖给出价最高的人。活少的时候，就翻检废墟或坠毁的天空船，勉强糊口。没多久，你用开锁器的手法已和用剑一样娴熟。

English: You were sought out by the inquisition, who trained you as an agent. In the hunt for god worshippers you were taught their false histories, their untruths. You learned to sniff out their dens and decipher their hidden secrets.
Chinese: 宗教裁判所找上了你，把你训练成特务。在追捕神明崇拜者的过程中，你学习了他们虚假的历史、他们的谎言。你学会了嗅出他们的巢穴、破译他们隐藏的秘密。

English: Frontline combat was always so... vulgar. You honed your skills in secret, while clinking glasses with powerful people in elegant ballrooms. When your employers slipped you a name, you killed with subtlety.
Chinese: 前线厮杀总是那么……粗俗。你在暗地里磨炼技艺，在华美的舞会上与权贵碰杯。当雇主悄悄递给你一个名字，你便不动声色地取人性命。

English: Years of killing took its toll. You slept lightly, a knife under the pillow, if you slept at all. Noises made you twitchy; in dark places, you saw the men you'd killed. One day you snapped, and killed a man in broad daylight, for all to see.
Chinese: 经年累月的杀戮终有代价。你睡得很浅——如果还能睡的话——枕头底下压着一把刀。一点声响就让你神经紧绷；在黑暗处，你看见自己杀过的人。终于有一天，你崩溃了，光天化日之下杀了一个人，当着所有人的面。

English: You'd had your fill of bloodshed, but saw no way out. So you deserted. Your old comrades pursued you, over islands and sky ships, until you could run no more.
Chinese: 你已受够了流血，却看不到出路。于是你逃了。昔日战友穷追不舍，跨越岛屿与天空之船，直到你再也无法奔逃。

English: To excel in combat, you studied not just the blade, but the secret language of the cosmos. You wrote spells of your own design - dangerous and illegal without training. But a spell backfired, killing the wrong person and sealing your fate.
Chinese: 为了在战斗中出类拔萃，你不仅研习刀剑，还钻研宇宙的密语。你编写自己设计的法术——未经训练而施法既危险又违法。可一道法术失了手，杀错了人，也注定了你的命运。

English: Your knowledge in weaponry opened new avenues; you became an arms dealer, trading items of lethality. Such pursuits, however, are as profitable as they are illegal - and your luck didn't last forever.
Chinese: 你在武器上的造诣打开了新的门路；你成了军火商，买卖致命之物。然而这行当有利也有非法——你的好运没能一直持续。

English: You could take care of yourself, and were known for it. A Slev cartel recruited you as muscle; when they smuggled nefarious texts or illegal potions, you were there to make sure things didn't go south. And when they did, you cracked some skulls.
Chinese: 你能照顾好自己，并且因此出了名。一个斯列夫的犯罪集团雇你当打手；他们走私邪恶典籍或违禁药剂时，你在场确保事情不出岔子。出了岔子的时候，你就敲碎几颗脑袋。

English: Thievery came easy. Your picks danced through locks with a lover's touch. You stole spells from scholars and treasures from sky ships. The city was yours, its doors wide open.
Chinese: 偷窃对你来说轻而易举。你的开锁器以恋人般的轻柔在锁芯里起舞。你从学者那里偷法术，从天空船上偷财宝。整座城市都是你的，门为大开。

English: In the Apostatic Union, some secrets are worth more than gold. You fraternized with cultists, traded illegal tomes and sought dangerous knowledge. If something was hidden, you could find it... for a price.
Chinese: 在叛教联盟，有些秘密比黄金还值钱。你与邪教徒厮混，交易非法典籍，追寻危险的知识。只要东西藏着，你就能找到它……当然，得收钱。

English: In a bloody business, you kept your hands clean. In pubs and markets you built your network; mingling and scheming. Elsewhere, nefarious deeds were committed and you were, of course, never involved. But your purse was never empty, either.
Chinese: 在血腥的行当里，你始终两手干净。你在酒馆与集市上编织人脉，周旋谋划。别处发生的肮脏勾当，你当然从未参与。不过，你的钱袋也从没空过。

English: In your line of business, you always kept your guard up - but sometimes it's not enough. In the end, you were sold out and left for dead, in a pool of your own blood.
Chinese: 干你这行的，时刻都保持着警惕——但有时警惕也不够。最终，你被出卖，被扔在血泊中等死。

English: As the years passed, your paranoia grew. You were always on the move; you never stayed in the same bed twice. Turned out you were right, though - they really were hunting you. And they found you.
Chinese: 岁月流逝，你的疑心越来越重。你总是四处漂泊；同一张床绝睡第二次。事实证明你是对的——他们确实在追捕你。而且他们找到了你。

English: You hoarded spells and potions; many valuable, many useful. But too many. When fumbling for an invisibility spell, you accidentally opened a portal into an Inquisition ship - the worst destination possible.
Chinese: 你囤积法术与药剂；许多贵重，许多好用。但太多了。摸索一道隐身咒时，你失手打开了一座通往宗教裁判所船舰的传送门——再糟糕不过的目的地。

English: You always had a knack for acquiring ill-gotten goods; but eventually, this grew into an underground empire of trade. With success came infamy, and a brutal Inquisition raid put you behind bars.
Chinese: 你向来精于搞到来路不正的货；最终，这成了一座地下商业帝国。成功伴随恶名，一场残酷的宗教裁判所突袭把你送进了牢房。

English: At the first chance, you set out on your own. You travelled the sky realms, stowing on ships and sleeping under the stars. You learned much of the world, but you also learned how to defend yourself, as the open road is not for the faint hearted.
Chinese: 一有机会，你便独自上路。你游历天空诸陆，偷搭船只，枕着星空入眠。你了解了世界的许多，也学会了如何自保——因为漂泊之路不属于懦弱的心。

English: You proved adept with machinery, so the Aetherists' Guild took you as an apprentice. You learned hermetic magic, to seal a ship so it may touch the cosmos - but also the simple logic of locks and traps.
Chinese: 你展现出机械方面的天赋，乙太师公会便收你为徒。你学习了密封魔法，让船能够封闭舱室、触摸苍穹——也学会了锁与陷阱的简单逻辑。

English: Being accepted into a prestigious Byonne university, you learned of ancient gods, dead cities and the language of the universe. But above all, you learned to look beyond the obvious; to find the hidden truths of all things.
Chinese: 你考入拜昂一所名校，学习古老的神明、消亡的城市和宇宙的语言。但最重要的是，你学会了越过表象去看；找到万物的隐秘真相。

English: Your treatises and polemics showed promise; you gained a position in a council in Riova, the political heart of the Apostatic Union. Before long you were hurling opinions into deafening debates.
Chinese: 你的论文与雄辩崭露锋芒；你在里奥瓦——叛教联盟的政治心脏——的议会里谋得席位。没多久，你便在震耳欲聋的辩论中挥洒观点了。

English: After learning of a powerful artifact in an ancient temple, you set out to obtain it. You trained to defend yourself against traps and monsters alike; but not to evade the Inquisition - who forbid the plunder of such places.
Chinese: 听说古神殿中有一件强大圣物后，你便动身去取。你训练自己抵御陷阱与怪物；却没学过如何躲避宗教裁判所——他们禁止劫掠那些地方。

English: In your studies, you learned of a forbidden word. A word whispered only in the dark; that opened unseen doors. Before you knew it, you were hunted by a shadowy organisation and forced to flee for your life.
Chinese: 求学期间，你得知了一个禁忌之词。一个只在黑暗中低语的词；能打开看不见的门。不知不觉间，你已被一个隐秘组织追捕，不得不亡命奔逃。

English: You were always adept at spellcraft, but eventually it became an obsession. You wrote a spell of such complex cipher logic that, when cast, it tore a hole in the veil of reality - making you a wanted criminal overnight.
Chinese: 你在咒术上向来有天分，但最终它成了执念。你写下一道密文逻辑极其复杂的法术，一经施放便撕裂了现实的帷幕——让你一夜之间成了通缉犯。

English: You opened a bookshop in Riova; an emporium of knowledge, frequented by the most learned folk in the Apostatic Union. But when word got out that you stocked forbidden texts, the Inquisition showed you no mercy.
Chinese: 你在里奥瓦开了一家书店——一座知识的殿堂，叛教联盟最有学问的人都常来光顾。但当藏有禁书的消息走漏，宗教裁判所对你没有半点仁慈。

English: To your family's chagrin, you sought the base thrill of combat. You enrolled as an infantry-councillor, honing your skills of both swordplay and debate; for in the Apostatic Union elections are decided by both.
Chinese: 让家族懊恼的是，你追求起战斗的低级刺激。你以步兵议员的身份入伍，同时磨炼剑术与辩才；因为在叛教联盟，选举由这两者共同决定。

English: Though your family kept up appearances, their coffers were empty. You embraced a dubious morality; stealing from the dinners and balls you were invited to. At first it was just the odd goblet, but you performed ever more nefarious heists.
Chinese: 家族虽然维持着体面，金库却已见底。你拥抱了一种可疑的道德观；从你受邀赴宴的晚宴和舞会上顺走东西。起初只是偶尔一只高脚杯，但你的劫案越来越见不得光。

English: While others attended parties, your head was buried in dusty tomes. You amassed a great library, frequenting bookshops and lectures. But people whispered that your tastes were unsavoury; that you sought banned texts and occult grimoires...
Chinese: 别人赴宴作乐，你却埋头于积灰的典籍。你攒起一座宏大的藏书库，出入书店与讲座。但人们私下议论你的品味不堪；说你搜寻禁书与神秘魔法书……

English: You shunned professions of esteem, choosing instead the life of a socialite. You graced parties in Vena, Bayonne and Lundel where wine and gossip flowed. Your family's money bought you much, but the flash of your smile bought you more.
Chinese: 你鄙弃体面的职业，选择了社交名流的生活。维纳、巴约讷、伦德尔的宴会上都有你的身影，酒水与流言在那里流淌。家族的财富为你买到许多，而你嫣然一笑买到的更多。

English: You trained for one of the most important elections in the Apostatic Union. Such events are bloody and brutal, but in the end, your battle-council was found guilty of rigging; landing you in a jail cell.
Chinese: 你为叛教联盟最重要的一场选举磨砺多年。这类活动血腥而残酷，但最终，你的选举战团被判舞弊；你锒铛入狱。

English: Being a member of a noble family can bring a life of privilege, but when such a family falls from grace - they can fall hard. Your family was hunted and killed for their crimes, and you alone managed to flee.
Chinese: 身为贵族家庭的一员可以尽享特权，但当这样的家族失势——往往摔得很惨。你的家族因罪遭到追杀，满门尽灭，唯有你一人逃脱。

English: Spellcasting was always a favourable pursuit; you entertained and impressed many. But you fell foul of the law when you accidentally made the clothes of a whole town disappear, leaving its people stark naked.
Chinese: 施法向来是讨喜的营生；你逗乐并折服了无数人。但你惹上了官司——你失手让整座镇子的衣服凭空消失，全镇的人一丝不挂。

English: Skilled in commerce, you established a network of shops - and even bought a merchant airship of your own. But when artifacts of god worship were found in your warehouse, the Inquisition detained you.
Chinese: 你精于商道，建立起一片商铺网络——甚至买了自己的商用飞艇。但当仓库里搜出神明崇拜的圣物，宗教裁判所扣押了你。

English: Gravity disabled. Numpad 8 & 2 to fly.  LS + A/B on gamepad.
Chinese: 重力已禁用。小键盘 8 和 2 飞行。手柄为左摇杆 + A/B。

English: God mode enabled - infinite HP and Mana, enemies won't aggro.
Chinese: 上帝模式已开启——无限生命与法力，敌人不会主动攻击。

English: You now have a shitton of items. HAVE FUN
Chinese: 你现在有一大堆物品了。玩得开心
罗穆路斯·凯隆七世勋爵

English: The world is broken. Its surface is cursed, inhospitable. Those that remain cling to islands in the sky. Somehow, you know this. ##You awaken, groggy and confused.
Chinese: 世界破碎了。地表遭到诅咒，不适栖居。幸存者们紧抓着天空中的岛屿。不知为何，你知道这些。##你醒来，头昏眼花，满心困惑。

English: A strange throb, inside you. Then another. You feel nauseous; your legs are weak. ##Suddenly - a loud bang and a sharp pain. You look down; there's a bloody hole in your chest. ##It appears your heart has exploded.
Chinese: 一阵奇怪的悸动，在你体内。接着又是一下。你感到恶心；双腿发软。##突然——一声巨响，一阵剧痛。你低头看去；胸口有个血淋淋的洞。##你的心脏似乎是爆炸了。

English: To equip items, open the ((Journal)) and navigate to the ((Equipment)) window.##Use the ((Loadout)) tab to equip weapons, armour and accessories.##The other two tabs allow you to equip for spells and quick-items.
Chinese: 要装备物品，打开((日志))并进入((装备))窗口。##使用((配置))栏装备武器、护甲和饰品。##另外两个栏位用于装备法术和快捷物品。

English: Spells and quick-items must be equipped in the ((Equipment)) menu before use.##Once equipped, press [[Spell]] to use spells and [[Item]] to use items.##You can scroll through equipped items with [[Switch Item]], or spells with [[Switch Spell]].
Chinese: 法术和快捷物品必须先在((装备))菜单中装备才能使用。##装备好后，按 [[法术]] 施放法术，按 [[物品]] 使用物品。##用 [[切换物品]] 或 [[切换法术]] 在已装备的物品或法术间轮换。

English: There are four ((Delusion Attributes)) - the fundamental attributes which govern your skills: ((Might, Wisdom, Guile)) and ((Persona)). ##To increase these attributes, you must find enough ((Glimmers of Delusion)) by exploring or completing quests.
Chinese: 共有四项((妄想属性))——掌管你技能的基础属性：((力量、智慧、灵巧))与((人格))。##要提升这些属性，你必须通过探索或完成任务收集足够多的((妄想微光))。

English: There are a number of ((Skills)) that determine your effectiveness at certain tasks.##Some are active-skills such as ((Lockpick)) or ((Lore)), which let you interact with objects in the world##Others are passive-skills such as ((Defence)) and ((Regen)). ##Skills can be improved by increasing the ((Delusion Attribute)) that governs it, or with special equipment.
Chinese: 有若干((技能))决定你完成特定任务的效果。##有些是主动技能，如((开锁))或((博识))，让你与世界中的物件互动##另一些是被动技能，如((防御))与((回复))。##技能可以通过提升掌管它的((妄想属性))来增强，也可以依靠特殊装备。

English: Some doors can be unlocked using a lockpick item.##Your chance of success is governed by your ((Lockpick)) skill - which is governed by your ((Guile)).##If an attempt fails, one of your lockpicks will break.
Chinese: 有些门可以用开锁器打开。##成功几率由你的((开锁))技能决定——而该技能由你的((灵巧))决定。##尝试失败时，一把开锁器会折断。

English: Some doors can be opened via hidden mechanisms. These secret switches require a high enough ((Lore)) skill and a small amount of mana to unlock.##The lore skill is governed by your ((Wisdom)). You may be able to further increase it using special equipment.
Chinese: 有些门可以通过隐藏机关打开。这些暗藏的开关需要足够高的((博识))技能和少量法力才能解锁。##博识技能由你的((智慧))决定。你也可以使用特殊装备进一步提升它。

English: Certain characters will withhold information from you. You must persuade them to speak freely.##Your success is determined by your ((Charm)) skill.##Charm is governed by your ((Persona)) attribute. You may be able to further increase it using special equipment.
Chinese: 某些角色会对你有所隐瞒。你必须说服他们畅所欲言。##成功与否取决于你的((魅惑))技能。##魅惑由你的((人格))属性决定。你也可以使用特殊装备进一步提升它。

English: With an unholstered weapon, press [[Attack]] to perform a normal attack.##Hold it for a slower but more powerful attack.
Chinese: 拔出武器后，按 [[攻击]] 进行普通攻击。##长按可施放更慢但更强的攻击。

English: In many cases, combat is avoidable. Press [[Crouch]] to toggle sneaking; your footsteps will not make any sound. ##Alternatively, you can sneak up behind an enemy to perform a stealth attack. Damage to unaware enemies will be multiplied.
Chinese: 多数情况下，战斗是可以避免的。按 [[蹲伏]] 切换潜行；你的脚步不会发出任何声音。##另外，你也可以绕到敌人身后发动偷袭。对未察觉敌人的伤害会成倍增加。

English: Your attack damage depends on your current ((Stamina)) - the lower your stamina, the less damage you'll do. ##Your maximum stamina will also deplete slowly over time. If it reaches half its original value, you will become ((Fatigued)); temporarily reducing all stats. ##Maximum Stamina can be restored by sleeping in a bed or using a Stamina Potion.
Chinese: 你的攻击伤害取决于当前的((体力))——体力越低，伤害越小。##体力上限也会随时间慢慢消耗。若降到初始值的一半，你会陷入((疲劳))，所有属性暂时降低。##体力上限可以通过睡床或使用体力药水恢复。

English: Hold [[Block]] to reduce incoming enemy damage.##If you time a block just as an enemy attack lands, you will ((Parry)) it. Successful parries negate all damage and will stagger the enemy. ##Blocking and Parrying are not possible when your stamina is empty.
Chinese: 按住 [[格挡]] 减少敌人攻击造成的伤害。##若在敌人攻击命中的瞬间格挡，便会触发((招架))。成功的招架可以完全抵消伤害并使敌人踉跄。##体力耗尽时无法格挡与招架。

English: Crafting Stations will allow you to modify your equipment.##Ore can improve weapons and armour. Thread can improve clothing.##Search the world for rare crafting items to create even better equipment.
Chinese: 锻造台让你可以改造装备。##矿石可以强化武器和护甲。丝线可以强化衣物。##在世界上搜寻稀有锻造材料，打造更精良的装备。

English: Alchemy Stations will allow you to brew usable items by combining two ingredients.##Herbs can be found around the world and can be combined to create potions##Many different items can be combined for unique results.
Chinese: 炼金台让你可以组合两种原料调配可用物品。##草药遍布世界，可以组合调配成药水##许多不同物品都能组合出独特的效果。

English: ((Crystal Points)) will restore your ((Mana)). ##Use the Home spell to return to the last Crystal Point visited. You will also appear at the last used Crystal Point when loading the game.
Chinese: ((水晶锚点))会恢复你的((法力))。##使用归乡法术可回到最近到访的水晶锚点。读档时你也会出现在最后使用的水晶锚点。

English: The loadout of a petty thief. ##This [[Demo Class]] is agile, with some skill in [[Lockpicking]]. You will start with a dagger and some basic leather armour. ##((Classes are only available in this demo. In the full game, you will craft your character as you play.))
Chinese: 小贼的配置。##这个[[试玩职业]]敏捷出众，具备一些[[开锁]]技能。你将以一把匕首和基础皮甲开局。##((职业仅在本试玩版中提供。正式版中，你将在游戏过程中塑造自己的角色。))

English: The loadout of a seasoned warrior. ##This [[Demo Class]] has strong combat skills and starts with sturdy armour, but you will lack the more specialised skills of other classes.  ##((Classes are only available in this demo. In the full game, you will craft your character as you play.))
Chinese: 老练战士的配置。##这个[[试玩职业]]战斗技能强劲，以坚固护甲开局，但缺乏其他职业的专精技能。##((职业仅在本试玩版中提供。正式版中，你将在游戏过程中塑造自己的角色。))

English: The loadout of a spellcaster. ##This [[Demo Class]] has a range of spells and a decent [[Lore]] skill, though they lack a good offensive weapon. ##((Classes are only available in this demo. In the full game, you will craft your character as you play.))
Chinese: 施法者的配置。##这个[[试玩职业]]拥有多种法术和不俗的[[博识]]技能，但缺少一件趁手的攻击武器。##((职业仅在本试玩版中提供。正式版中，你将在游戏过程中塑造自己的角色。))

English: The loadout of a confident noble. ##This [[Demo Class]] is adept at dialogue challenges, with high [[Charm]] and [[Barter]] skills. ##((Classes are only available in this demo. In the full game, you will craft your character as you play.))
Chinese: 自信贵族的配置。##这个[[试玩职业]]精于对话考验，[[魅惑]]与[[交易]]技能很高。##((职业仅在本试玩版中提供。正式版中，你将在游戏过程中塑造自己的角色。))

English: Your current status is represented by three stats; ((Health)), ((Mana)) and ((Stamina)).##To restore your status, rest in a bed or drink a potion.
Chinese: 你当前的状态由三项数值表示：((生命))、((法力))与((体力))。##要恢复状态，可在床上休息或喝下药水。

English: A powerful entity has taken an interest in you. ##By their grace, you will be plucked from the jaws of death and transported to a ((Death Shrine)), without losing items or progress.
Chinese: 一位强大的存在对你产生了兴趣。##承蒙恩典，你将从死亡边缘被拉回，传送至((死亡神龛))，不损失任何物品与进度。

English: The Apostatic Union has set up many checkpoint bridges throughout the land. ##To pass into another region, you will require a ((Union Passport)) - one per checkpoint.
Chinese: 叛教联盟在各地设置了众多关卡桥。##要进入另一个区域，你需要一本((联盟护照))——每座关卡一本。

English: The game saves your progress at regular intervals, such as when crossing between regions, using a ((Crystal Point)) or quitting the game.
Chinese: 游戏会定期保存进度，例如跨越区域、使用((水晶锚点))或退出游戏时。

English: ((Glimmers of Delusion)) can be obtained by gathering blue skulls or by completing quests. ##Collect enough Glimmers to gain a ((Delusion Point)), which can be used to upgrade your Attributes.##Open your ((Journal)) and go to the ((Character)) window to spend Delusions.
Chinese: ((妄想微光))可以通过收集蓝色骷髅或完成任务获得。##收集足够多的微光即可获得((妄想点))，用于升级你的属性。##打开((日志))进入((角色))窗口消耗妄想。

English: As the great neuron star moves through the sky, the day progresses through dawn, noon, dusk and night.##Some areas change at different times of day. ##To progress time, rest in a bed.
Chinese: 随着巨大的神经元星划过天空，一天由黎明、正午、黄昏行至夜晚。##某些区域会随一天中的不同时间而变化。##在床上休息即可推进时间。

English: Resting in beds recovers your health, mana and maximum stamina. ##Beds can be cheaply rented at inns.##You may also find unattended beds throughout the world. However, some are unsafe, and you will be taking a chance by resting in them.
Chinese: 在床上休息可以恢复生命、法力和体力上限。##床铺可以在旅店廉价租用。##你在世界中也会发现无人看管的床。不过有些并不安全，睡在里面可是要碰运气的。

English: Open the chest to get the ((Manor Deed)), then use the small wooden house model to upgrade your manor. Some upgrades require you to rest in a bed; there is one behind you.
Chinese: 打开箱子获得((庄园地契))，然后使用小木屋模型升级你的庄园。部分升级需要你在床上休息；你身后就有一张。

English: You cannot leave this island in this demo build.
Chinese: 试玩版中无法离开这座岛。

English: With an airship in your possession, you are now a veritable sky captain. ##You may cast the [[Emergency Airship Reembarkation]] spell to return to your airship at any time. Do this if you become stranded away from your ship. ##You may disembark your airship anywhere, but it is often wise to do so at [[Airship Docks]], where you can interact with [[Airship Stations]] to upgrade and modify your ship. To purchase new upgrades, visit the different [[Airship Guild]] members who are often found at Docks. ##If you disembark while flying above solid ground, your airship will [[drop anchor]]. Interact with the anchor to [[descend]] or [[ascend]] promptly. ##You should also check the [[Controls]] menu to familiarise yourself with how the airship handles.
Chinese: 拥有了飞艇，你就是名副其实的天空船长。##你可以随时施放[[紧急重返飞艇]]法术回到飞艇上。若你被困在远离飞船的地方，就这么做。##你可以在任何地方降落，但通常更明智的做法是停靠在[[飞艇码头]]，在那里与[[飞艇站台]]互动即可升级和改造飞船。要购买新升级，请拜访[[飞艇商会]]的成员，他们通常在码头出没。##若你在陆地正上方下船，飞艇会[[抛锚停驻]]。与船锚互动即可快速[[下降]]或[[上升]]。##你也应该查看[[控制]]菜单，熟悉一下飞艇的操纵方式。

English: Here lies the largest Emberian ruin in the Oneiric Isles. ##We trade in underlands metal & Embieran antiques.
Chinese: 此处是梦幻群岛最大的余烬遗迹。##我们经营地下之地金属与余烬古董。

English: On this year 1406, the town of Rustburg is hereby abandoned. By decree of the Apostatics, no coin shall pass b'tween hands here. ##Let this be a warning to all who harbour Wikkans and their vile gods.
Chinese: 1406 年，锈堡镇就此废弃。奉背教者敕令，此地不得易手任何钱币。##凡窝藏维坎教徒及其邪神者，以此为鉴。

English: You are hereby entering the domain of the Cadavers. ##Only those loyal to our cause will be granted entry to Cadaver Keep.
Chinese: 你正在进入尸骸派的领地。##唯有忠于我们事业者方可进入尸骸要塞。

English: This statue stands in memoriam to all the Endless who lost their lives in the Cadaver Crusades. ##All creatures are permitted to follow their nature, be they predator or prey. None should feel shame for their instincts.
Chinese: 这座雕像纪念所有在尸骸十字军中丧生的无尽者。##众生皆可遵循其天性，无论捕食者还是猎物。本能无需羞耻。

English: The Apostatic Union Geological Society has classified this a Roaming Island, as it has been known to drift erratically. In other words, it might not be here forever...
Chinese: 联盟地质学会已将此岛列为漂流岛，因为它素来漂移无常。换言之，它未必会永远待在这里……

English: The owner of this place won't let you past this point.
Chinese: 这里的主人不允许你越过此处。

English: You recognise these old machines are God War relics; inoperable and mostly useless. Such strange contraptions are rarely seen outside the Clockwork Kingdom these days.
Chinese: 你认出这些老机器是神之战的遗物；早已无法运转，基本没什么用。如今这样的古怪机关，在发条王国之外已很少见了。

English: An assortment of maps, notes and diagrams clutter the table, detailing the planned exploits of the Dark Star mercenaries. One in particular catches your eye; an expedition to the cursed underlands, far below the skyrealms...
Chinese: 各种地图、笔记和图示堆满桌面，详述着黑星佣兵们的行动计划。其中一份格外引人注目：一次前往天空领域深处的受诅咒地下之地的远征……

English: Your maximum Health has been temporarily buffed.You can practically feel the cipher magic in your heartbeat.
Chinese: 你的生命上限获得临时增益。你几乎能从心跳中感受到密文魔法。

English: Your Agility has been temporarily buffed. You feel light as a feather.
Chinese: 你的敏捷获得临时增益。你感觉轻如鸿毛。

English: Your Regen has been temporarily buffed. You will recover much faster.
Chinese: 你的回复获得临时增益。你的恢复速度会快得多。

English: Your Spellcast has been temporarily buffed. Careful not to singe your eyebrows with those spells, now.
Chinese: 你的施法获得临时增益。小心别让那些法术燎了眉毛。

English: Your Attack has been temporarily buffed. You could cleave a helmet in two. Probably.
Chinese: 你的攻击获得临时增益。你几乎能把头盔一劈两半。大概吧。

English: Your Lockpick has been temporarily buffed. No keyhole can stop you.
Chinese: 你的开锁获得临时增益。没有锁孔拦得住你。

English: Your Charm has been temporarily buffed. Who could possibly resist you?
Chinese: 你的魅惑获得临时增益。还有谁能抗拒你呢？

English: Your Barter has been temporarily buffed. You're not going to be short-changed anytime soon.
Chinese: 你的交易获得临时增益。短时间内没人能找错你的钱。

English: Your Lore has been temporarily buffed. It all seems so much clearer, suddenly.
Chinese: 你的博识获得临时增益。一切忽然变得清晰多了。

English: Your Defence has been temporarily buffed. You feel like a castle. A rather fleshy, squidgy castle.
Chinese: 你的防御获得临时增益。你感觉自己像座城堡。一座肉乎乎、软趴趴的城堡。

English: Your Mana has been temporarily buffed. Your mind fizzles with extra power.
Chinese: 你的法力获得临时增益。脑海中噼啪作响地涌动着额外的力量。

English: Your Stamina has been temporarily buffed. Those hills won't get you out of breath now.
Chinese: 你的体力获得临时增益。那些山坡再也累不倒你了。

English: Your stamina is low, so you have become Fatigued - which has reduced all your main Attributes by 1. To recover, rest in a bed or use a Stamina Potion.
Chinese: 你的体力过低，因此陷入疲劳——所有主属性降低 1 点。要恢复，请在床上休息或使用体力药水。

English: You have become Cursed, lowering all your main Attributes by 1.
Chinese: 你被诅咒了，所有主属性降低 1 点。

English: You are poisoned! You will take damage over time.
Chinese: 你中毒了！你将持续受到伤害。

English: You are Lucky. Everything just seems that little bit easier, all of a sudden. All your main Attributes have been raised by 1.
Chinese: 你正处于幸运状态。一切忽然都变得轻松了一点点。你的所有主属性提升 1 点。

English: Your Regen has been temporarily buffed. You will recover much faster.
Chinese: 你的回复获得临时增益。你的恢复速度会快得多。

English: Your Spellcast has been temporarily buffed. Careful not to singe your eyebrows with those spells, now.
Chinese: 你的施法获得临时增益。小心别让那些法术燎了眉毛。

English: Your Defence has been temporarily buffed. You feel like a castle. A rather fleshy, squidgy castle.
Chinese: 你的防御获得临时增益。你感觉自己像座城堡。一座肉乎乎、软趴趴的城堡。

English: A spell is gradually restoring your Health. The cipher magic flows through your veins, giving your skin a pale blue glow.
Chinese: 一道法术正在缓缓恢复你的生命。密文魔法流过你的血管，让你的皮肤泛起淡蓝色的光。

English: You have coated your weapons in a deadly poison. Enemies you strike will take damage over time.
Chinese: 你已给自己的武器涂上剧毒。被你击中的敌人将持续受到伤害。

English: You have been buffed by an ally, increasing your stats.
Chinese: 你获得了同伴的增益，属性得到提升。

English: A spell is greatly boosting your Agility. Be careful not to run off the edge of the Skyrealms, now...
Chinese: 一道法术大幅提升了你的敏捷。当心别跑出天空领域的边缘……

English: You can temporarily see the truth of things. This effect reveals secrets that have been hidden by illusion magic.
Chinese: 你能暂时看清事物的真相。该效果会揭示被幻术隐藏的秘密。

English: You are temporarily invisible; your enemies won't see you coming.
Chinese: 你暂时隐形；敌人不会看见你的到来。

English: You are drunk. Some stats have been raised, others lowered. Remember to drink responsibly, or you may wake up in a lake with no pants.
Chinese: 你喝醉了。有些数值提升，有些下降。记得适量饮酒，否则你可能醒在某个湖里，裤子都没了。

English: Your sleep is restless; your dreams are strange. ##You see a city of sparkling towers crumble to dust in a searing light. You feel a monster slide down your throat, warming and pleasant. And you hear the screams of your mother as you flee for your life. ##You wake in a cold sweat. Blood is on your pillow.
Chinese: 你的睡眠不安稳；梦境古怪。##你看见一座高塔闪耀的城市在灼目的光中化为齑粉。你感到一只怪物滑下你的喉咙，温暖而惬意。你听见母亲的尖叫，而你正夺命奔逃。##你在冷汗中惊醒。枕头上是血。

English: You dream of a journey, through foreign towns and exotic lands. But when you return home, all has changed. You search for your friends, but cannot find them. You search for your lover, but they are gone. You find your parents; but they are dead and buried under gravestones. ##Suddenly, the future unfurls before you; plain as day. Everyone you love will turn to dust. ##You wake screaming. There is blood running down your neck.
Chinese: 你梦见一段旅程，穿过异国的小镇与新奇的土地。但当你回到家，一切都变了。你寻找朋友，却找不到他们。你寻找爱人，但他们已经不在。你找到了父母；他们已死去，埋在墓碑之下。##忽然，未来在你眼前展开；清晰如白昼。你爱的每个人都将化为尘土。##你尖叫着醒来。鲜血正沿着你的脖颈流下。

English: You dream of soaring through the skyrealms. Your wings take you over dense forests; sprawling metropolises and crumbling ruins. You land in a field of brilliant flowers under a green star, and feel a cool breeze embrace you. ##You wake, inspired, knowing that anything is possible. You barely notice the blood on your pillow.
Chinese: 你梦见翱翔于天空领域。你的双翼带你越过茂密的森林；绵延的都市与崩塌的废墟。你降落在一颗绿色星辰下繁花似锦的原野，感到清凉的微风拥抱着你。##你醒来，心潮澎湃，确信一切皆有可能。你几乎没注意到枕头上的血。

English: A two hundred year manor, once stately and fine, that has fallen into disrepair. ##The manor grounds comprise an entire island, just off the south of Hallowshire. With the right investor this could be a thriving estate once more. ##For inquiries, visit the clerk in Hallow Town council.
Chinese: 一座两百年历史的庄园，曾气派堂皇，如今已年久失修。##庄园属地包含整座岛屿，就在哈洛郡以南近旁。若有合适的投资人，它或能重现昔日兴旺。##垂询请至哈洛镇议会找书记员。

English: You find papers and rolls of parchment outlining the study of various monsters. ##Most seem to feature the vierme; a parasitic organism that uses its host to feed on the dreams of its prey.
Chinese: 你找到一些文件和成卷的羊皮纸，勾勒出对各种怪物的研究。##大多数内容都围绕维尔姆：一种寄生生物，利用宿主取食猎物的梦境。

English: You find numerous documents on the theory and practice of cipher magic. They seem to all focus on a single spell that could imprison even the most violent of creatures, binding them to a limited radius. Some pages are torn, with sections removed. You cannot find the spell in question.
Chinese: 你找到大量关于密文魔法理论与实践的文件。它们似乎都聚焦于同一道法术——能把最狂暴的生物也囚禁起来，束缚在有限的范围内。有些书页被撕去，段落缺失。你找不到那道法术本身。

English: A small smithy was in operation here; perhaps just to maintain just a limited, personal arsenal. The blades are of a strange design and rusted beyond repair. It has not been used in some time.
Chinese: 这里曾运营着一间小铁匠铺；或许只是用来维护一批有限的私人武备。这些剑刃设计古怪，锈蚀得无法修复。它已经有一段时间没被使用了。

English: The statue has a haunting presence, but it looks as though some elements are missing. On closer inspection, this seems to be intentional. Perhaps replacing the missing parts will yield some hidden function.
Chinese: 这尊雕像有种萦绕人心的气息，但看起来缺了一些部件。仔细一看，这似乎是刻意为之。也许换上缺失的部分会触发某种隐藏功能。

English: This statue seems to be missing something.
Chinese: 这尊雕像似乎缺了点什么。

English: This statue is still missing something.
Chinese: 这尊雕像还缺着点什么。

English: To prospective or current owners of the Thornwood Manor property: ##This mine is in disrepair and has been sealed shut. ##Its refurbishment will be included in the [[Workshop Upgrade]] available for purchase at a [[Property Station]].
Chinese: 致荆棘木庄园的现任或有意购买者：##此矿坑年久失修，已被封闭。##其翻修将包含在[[房产工作站]]有售的[[工坊升级]]之中。

English: To prospective or current owners of the Thornwood Manor property: ##This chapel is in disrepair and has been sealed shut. ##Its refurbishment will be included in the [[Library Upgrade]] available for purchase at a [[Property Station]].
Chinese: 致荆棘木庄园的现任或有意购买者：##此礼拜堂年久失修，已被封闭。##其翻修将包含在[[房产工作站]]有售的[[图书室升级]]之中。

English: To prospective or current owners of the Thornwood Manor property: ##This cavern annex is in disrepair and has been sealed shut. ##Its refurbishment will be included in the [[Garden Upgrade]] available for purchase at a [[Property Station]].
Chinese: 致荆棘木庄园的现任或有意购买者：##此洞穴附室年久失修，已被封闭。##其翻修将包含在[[房产工作站]]有售的[[花园升级]]之中。

English: In response to recent Outrages by the vile SABOTEUR, Its Majesty's Servants are conducting a SECURITY OPERATION in this District.##Anyone found in violation of this Order shall be presumed an Agent of the Saboteur & treated accordingly.##LONG LIVE THE KING.##Century 0, Year 27, Month 6, Day 45
Chinese: 鉴于卑劣的破坏者近来犯下的暴行，它陛下的仆从正在本区执行一项安全行动。##任何违抗本命令者，一律视同破坏者的党羽，依此处置。##国王万岁。##零世纪 27 年 6 月 45 日

English: It is of utmost Gravity that you immediately report all signs of Corruption to the proper Authorities in your District. KNOW THESE OMENS:##1) Unusual Behaviour or physical Defects among Livestock & other Animals.##2) Confusion in finding your Way through familiar Places.##3) Mirages of the Eye & Ear.##4) Taste or Smell of Lilac where there is no Lilac.##LONG LIVE THE KING.##Century 0, Year 26, Month 3, Day 13
Chinese: 务必立刻向你所在区的有关当局上报一切腐化迹象，此事关乎重大。谨记这些征兆：##1）牲畜及其他动物出现异常行为或生理缺陷。##2）在熟悉的地方迷失方向。##3）眼耳出现幻象幻听。##4）没有丁香处闻到丁香的气味或味道。##国王万岁。##零世纪 26 年 3 月 13 日

English: Back - Nun of your Bisnis!!! ##Strictly NO Flyers, Pamphlits, Missionrys, Carolllers, Toenaile Collectors, or other Scoundrels. ##BEWARE OF MAN. ##- Oleg Myshkin
Chinese: 外出——别管闲事！！！##严禁传单、小册子、传教士、唱颂歌的、收脚趾甲的，以及其他无赖之辈。##小心人类。##—— 奥列格·米什金

English: The city of ((PROGRESS)) is where our glorious Kingdom is ((FORGING the FUTURE)) - with our own Hands. Exciting Opportunities are available for: ##Wire Weavers ##Phosphorous Whiskers ##Steam Lathe & Drill Press Operators ##Compressed Air Workers (hazard pay applies) ##Infrahull Rune Engravers (must be shorter than 4 ft 11) ##Void Fumigators & Dethaumatisers ##LONG LIVE THE KING. Century 0, Year 19, Month 6, Day 59
Chinese: ((进步))城是我们光荣的王国用双手((锻造未来))的地方。现诚聘以下激动人心的岗位：##织丝工 ##磷须工 ##蒸汽车床与钻床操作员 ##压缩空气工（有危险津贴）##下颅符文雕刻师（身高须低于 4 英尺 11 英寸）##虚空熏蒸员与祛魔法员##国王万岁。零世纪 19 年 6 月 59 日

English: Citizens Wong, Murray, Ustinov – Guarding schoolhouse ##Citizens Heinz, Krupke, Singh, Ghazaryan – Street patrol ##Citizens Roth, Doyle, Filipovich – Welfare checks & barricade maintenance ##Citizen Onwurah – Creche duty ##Citizens Gallo & Kenzie – Infirmary duty ##Citizen Muir – Quartermaster & talent show M.C.
Chinese: 公民王、默里、乌斯季诺夫——守卫校舍##公民海因茨、克鲁普克、辛格、加扎扬——街道巡逻##公民罗斯、多伊尔、菲利波维奇——慰问查访与路障维护##公民翁乌拉——托儿所值勤##公民加洛与肯齐——医务室值勤##公民缪尔——军需官兼才艺表演主持

English: This platform leads down to [[Pwyll Forest.]] ##BEWARE: Unlike the newfangled dual-directional lifts of Hallowshire, this lift is one-way.
Chinese: 此平台通往[[普威尔森林]]。##注意：与哈洛郡那些新式双向升降机不同，这台升降机是单向的。
此路通往##[[炫光要塞]]##堡垒。

English: This way to ##[[PWYLL]],##Home to Pwyll Village.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[普威尔]]，##普威尔村所在之地。

English: This way to ##[[PWYLL VILLAGE]],##Purveyors of the prophetic Scryshroom Tea.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[普威尔村]]，##先知窥菇茶的产地。

English: This way to ##[[GOD WAR FORT]].##((The above has been crossed out, and someone has scrawled))##The Esteemed ROTTEN ONION Mercenary Camp
Chinese: 此路通往##[[神战堡垒]]。##((上面的字被划掉了，有人潦草地改写为))##尊贵的烂洋葱佣兵营地

English: This way to ##[[THE SACRED SHROOM]].##((Someone has scrawled)) Fuck Aenguin ((underneath.))
Chinese: 此路通往##[[神圣蘑菇]]。##((有人潦草地写着))去他妈的安圭因((就刻在下面))

English: This way to ##[[THE WOBBLY NOGGIN]].##Ye Olde Pub, serving ale and providing bed and board.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[摇晃酒馆]]。##老式酒馆，供应麦酒，提供食宿。

English: This way to ##[[HALLOWSHIRE]]##((A note has been added:))##Presided over by Hallow Town Council as of 1442.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[哈洛郡]]##((有人加了一行注记：))##自 1442 年起由哈洛镇议会管辖。

English: This way to ##[[HALLOW BELLTOWER]].## ((The sign is old and weathered.))
Chinese: 此路通往##[[哈洛钟楼]]。##((路牌老旧，饱经风霜。))

English: This way to ##[[HALLOW CASTLE]].## ((Someone has scrawled)) ACCURSED PLACE ((underneath)).
Chinese: 此路通往##[[哈洛城堡]]。##((有人潦草地写着))受诅之地((就刻在下面))

English: This way to ##[[HALLOW MINES]].## ((Someone has scrawled)) BANDITS ((underneath)).
Chinese: 此路通往##[[哈洛矿坑]]。##((有人潦草地写着))有土匪((就刻在下面))

English: This way to ##[[THE CITY OF SEPULCHRE]].##
This way to ##[[FLESH FARMS]].## Please visit the esteemed PENITENT THAW for enquiries.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[血肉农场]]。##垂询请拜访德高望重的忏悔者·索。

English: This way to ##[[THE CLOCKWORK KINGDOM]].## ((Someone has scrawled)) The Kingdom is BROKEN
Chinese: 此路通往##[[发条王国]]。##((有人潦草地写着))王国坏了

English: This way to ##[[FERROPOLIS]],## Largest and most prosperous city in the Oneiric Isles.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[铁城]]，##梦幻群岛最大、最繁荣的城市。

English: This way to ##[[ROYAL VISION WORKS]].##Inquire today about being a vision worker. The Kingdom wants your dreams!
Chinese: 此路通往##[[皇家幻象工坊]]。##今日垂询幻象工人职位。王国想要你的梦！
此路通往##[[莫罗佐夫之塔]]。##

English: This way to ##[[SAMMOL'S PLACE]].## ((A note has been added crudely:))##Horace Metcalfe stories rule!
Chinese: 此路通往##[[萨莫尔家]]。##((有人粗鲁地加了一句：))##霍勒斯·梅特卡夫的故事最棒！

English: This way to ##[[THE CORRUPTED LANDS]].##On command of the King, all citizens are forbidden entry.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[腐化之地]]。##奉国王之命，禁止一切公民入内。

English: This way to ##[[THE CITY OF PROGRESS]].##((An attached note:)) These ruins are OFF-LIMITS.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[进步城]]。##((附有字条：))这些废墟禁止入内。

English: This way to ##[[THE OBJECT GRAVEYARD]].##No fly-tipping!
Chinese: 此路通往##[[物件墓场]]。##禁止乱扔垃圾！

English: This way to ##[[ROYAL BEACON]].##Only Machinists permitted.
Chinese: 此路通往##[[皇家信标]]。##仅限机械师进入。

English: This way to ##[[THE LIBRARY OF UNTRUTH]].##

Various occult instruments litter the chamber. They've been assembled in a haphazard, amateurish way - but nonetheless, they seem to be having the desired effect. A pervasive sense of dread fills the air, and while the colossal god corpse that dominates the room appears to be lifeless - you sense an eldritch presence stirring. ##Amongst the clutter you find a key, covered in tiny mushrooms. Culwych will want to hear about this.
Chinese: 各种神秘法器散落一室。它们的组装方式杂乱又业余——但尽管如此，似乎正产生预期的效果。空气中弥漫着无孔不入的恐惧感，虽然占据整间屋子的巨大神尸看似毫无生气——你却能感到一个邪异的存在正在苏醒。##在杂物中你找到一把钥匙，上面长满了小蘑菇。卡尔威奇会想听听这件事。

English: The desk contains a number of scrawled notes, mostly pertaining to illusion spells. From what you find here, you can surmise that someone was trying to cast an illusion of significant scale. There are also numerous anatomical sketches of nautilobs... ##It seems that the giant monster isn't at all what it seems. It was a trick, this whole time.
Chinese: 书桌上有许多潦草的笔记，大多与幻术有关。从这些发现来看，你可以推断曾有人试图施展一场规模可观的幻术。还有许多鹦鹉螺妖的解剖草图……##看来那头巨型怪物根本不是它看起来的样子。从头到尾都是个骗局。

English: You find an assortment of Wikkan antiques; notes on contract-rites, old dusty garments and a number of unfamiliar instruments.
Chinese: 你找到一批维坎古物：契约仪式的笔记、积灰的旧衣裳，以及一些眼生的器具。

English: The nauseating stench of bile engulfs the flesh-chamber. Before you, a huge digestional tract pulsates and throbs with corrosive acid. ##It would seem as though this mushroom has ((organs.)) ##You can just make out a figure squirming behind layers of translucent flesh; you should investigate.
Chinese: 令人作呕的胆汁恶臭充斥着血肉之室。你面前是一条巨大的消化道，随着腐蚀性的酸液搏动起伏。##这株蘑菇似乎长着((器官。))##你能勉强看清半透明血肉层后有个身影在扭动；你应该去调查一下。

English: You feel a sudden sense of urgency...
Somewhere, an hourglass has run empty.
Chinese: 在某处，一只沙漏流尽了。

English: A sudden sense of euphoria: all the skulls are awakened.
Chinese: 一阵突如其来的狂喜：所有骷髅都已苏醒。

English: Can you beat your fastest time?
Chinese: 能打破你的最快纪录吗？

English: The total number of lives, human or otherwise,you have taken.
Chinese: 你夺走的生命总数，无论人还是其他。

English: The total number of times the Chained God has pulled you back from the brink of death.
Chinese: 锁链神将你从死亡边缘拉回的总次数。

English: The total number of lives your summoned creatures have taken in your name.
Chinese: 你的召唤物以你之名夺走的生命总数。

English: Your current Entice Spell level, used to determine whether an enemy can be Enticed to fight for you. The base level is determined by your Charm stat, but certain modifiers can increase Entice even further.
Chinese: 你当前的诱惑法术等级，用于判断能否诱惑敌人为你作战。基础等级由你的魅惑属性决定，但某些加成可以进一步提升诱惑。

English: The number of teas you have drunk. Remember to take tea breaks regularly, preferably somewhere with a lovely view.
Chinese: 你喝下的茶的数量。记得定期安排茶歇，最好选个风景宜人的地方。

English: The number of beers you have drunk. Please drink responsibly, and do not drive your airship while under the influence.
Chinese: 你喝下的啤酒的数量。请适量饮酒，切勿酒后驾驶飞艇。

English: Our world is long since shattered
Few would guess that our fate would be
Chinese: 少有人会想到，我们的命运将
那片几乎被遗忘的群岛

English: the deep forests and dark places

Chinese: 可怜的灵魂不朽地憔悴着
在其人造君主扭曲逻辑的

English: strives to transform not just the realm
Chinese: 力图改造的不止是国度

English: All these regions have their part to play
Chinese: 所有这些区域都将在这段
展开的故事中扮演一角。

English: But it begins fathoms below in the underlands
Chinese: 但故事始于地下之地的深处

English: where none can draw breath for long.
It is here that a secret waits
Chinese: 就在这里，一个秘密等待着
燃得比任何人都明亮的人。
